feature_title: Traces Open Result in New Tab

rationale.edition: All 13 changed paths live in OSS-owned locations: web/src/lib/core/Table/**, web/src/plugins/traces/**, and tests/ui-testing/**. None sit under enterprise/ or o2_enterprise/, and the touched components carry no isCloud/isEnterprise or withFeatureGate gating — the traces result list and core OTable render in the plain OSS build. This is an OSS feature.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change alters a real user-facing interaction (opening a trace result in a new tab via link, ctrl/cmd-click, middle-click, and a context-menu item), and there is no explicit opt-out: the trigger comment is empty and no tests-added label was passed.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change adds a new row-auxclick event to the core table and turns the traces operation-name cell into a real anchor, introducing new click/modifier behavior, a new context-menu entry, and multi-tab navigation that must be verified against the real UI (window.open target, href correctness, and the list staying put).
rationale.area: Traces. The bulk of the behavioral changes are in web/src/plugins/traces/SearchResult.vue and web/src/plugins/traces/components/TracesSearchResultList.vue, and the dev-authored sibling spec already lives under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/RegressionSet/Traces/.
rationale.group: The dev already registered the spec in ci_matrix_regression.json inside the Traces-Regression run_files list (adjacent to traces-15269-services-catalog-state.spec.js), and the spec carries @regression/@tracesRegression tags, so Traces-Regression is the correct matrix shard.
rationale.existing_tests: A new Playwright E2E spec — tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/RegressionSet/Traces/traces-15477-open-trace-new-tab.spec.js — is added in the diff and covers the new open-in-new-tab behavior (href presence, ctrl/cmd/middle-click new tab, plain-click same tab). The changed web/src/**/*.spec.ts files are Vitest unit tests and are not E2E coverage.
